title: OKF Toolkit Graph
description: Typed relationships from one OKF concept to other concepts in the bundle.
$comment: The graph schema is reusable by toolkit and project-specific concept schemas. Targets use explicit bundle-root-relative references.

relation.description: A relationship name defined by the composing concept schema.

target.description: A bundle-root-relative target concept, for example bundle:/concepts/example.md.
